source.citation: Ohishi, M., Takahashi, M., Fukuda, M., & Sato, F. (2023). Developing a Growth Model to Predict Dry Matter Production in Broccoli (Brassica oleracea L. var. italica) 'Ohayou'. The Horticulture Journal, 92(1), 77–87. https://doi.org/10.2503/hortj.QH-022
source.sourceVersion: Publisher full-text HTML, 2023, The Horticulture Journal 92(1)
source.artifactDigestStatus: SHA-256 supplied in the preregistration brief; no local source artifact was rehashed in this fixture-writing phase.
source.licenseOrReuseStatus: J-STAGE identifies the full-text journal page as free access. An explicit reuse license was not confirmed in the retrieved metadata. This fixture records bibliographic facts and numerical parameters only; it reproduces no article prose, table, or figure.
source.domain: Broccoli cultivar 'Ohayou', Spring Control treatment; the selected light-equation coefficients are not general broccoli defaults.

extinctionCoefficientK.method: Exponential relationship between intercepted total-solar-radiation rate and LAI, Figure 2.

radiationUseEfficiency.units: g above-ground DM per MJ intercepted total solar radiation
radiationUseEfficiency.method: Slope of the linear relationship between accumulated intercepted total solar radiation and total above-ground dry weight, Figure 3.

source.equationScope: The source supports the Spring Control K and RUE values and the total-solar interception/RUE equation only. Applying the source RUE to daily synthetic increments is a software integration adaptation, not a reproduction of the paper's accumulated observations.
unavailableSourceCoverage: No source-derived daily solar-radiation series is used.
No source-derived LAI-to-canopy-DM mapping, initial per-cell pools, or daily organ-allocation share is asserted.
No source-supported thermal, root-zone, nutrient, stress, or crop-maturity integration is asserted by this fixture.
No source zero-light experiment or independent daily dry-matter observations are available in this fixture.

modelDispatch.requiredImplementation: A new explicit v6 frozen-input validator branch and a new engine production-equation branch are required. Do not route this equation through the crop-parameters-v5 LINTUL-net-RUE validator or engine path.
modelDispatch.dailyForcingPersistence: Freeze solarRadiationMJm2Day in each persisted envSeries DailyEnvironment row. JSON number 0 means known zero; JSON null means unavailable; an omitted/undefined field is also unavailable. Do not derive it from or fall back to dliNaturalMol.
modelDispatch.cropParametersV5Compatibility: Existing crop-parameters-v5 records retain their LINTUL-net-RUE, DLI-to-PAR, and replay semantics. The v6 equation family is selected only by explicit frozen v6 inputs; ordinary new-run creation is unchanged.

persistenceContract.freezeRunModelInputsV4: An explicit v6 input remains crop-parameters-v6 through freezing and re-freezing; it is not downgraded to v5 or converted into LINTUL fields.
persistenceContract.forkRun: timeline.forkRun preserves the v6 equation family and every envSeries solar value while applying only its frozen management patch; replay of the resulting fork RunRecord is exact.
persistenceContract.createTwinRunRecord: twin.createTwinRunRecord preserves the v6 equation family and every envSeries solar value while adding scoped observations; replay of the resulting twin RunRecord is exact.
persistenceContract.persistedRunRecordReplay: JSON serialize and parse the complete RunRecord, then replay only its persisted config and envSeries; events, final cell state, qualification reasons, and summary must exactly match the pre-serialization replay.
persistenceContract.jsonSolarSerialization: JSON round-trip preserves numeric solar 0 as 0 and null as null. An undefined solar property is omitted by JSON serialization and remains unavailable after parse; it must not be replaced from DLI.
persistenceContract.unsupportedRecordPreservation: Unsupported historical or incomplete/unknown v6 records do not replay or reconstruct inputs from current catalog data; their distinctive stored summary and frozen config remain exactly preserved.

crop.catalogIdentityUse: Frozen routing snapshot only; no catalog cultivar or crop-accuracy claim.
crop.sourceCultivar: Ohayou is the source domain for the two light-equation coefficients only; equivalence to the catalog record is not asserted.

thermal.accumulationStart: Synthetic fixture transplant date; not a source start convention.
thermal.maturityEndpoint: Synthetic endpoint not reached during this five-day software fixture.
thermal.accumulationMethod: Synthetic daily thermal clock; no source method is asserted.
thermal.sourceCitation: Synthetic software fixture only; no crop thermal evidence is asserted.

equations.leafAreaIndex: LAI = (beginning canopy DM in g/m² / 1000) × synthetic SLA / (1 + synthetic leaf-stem partition parameter × beginning canopy DM in g/m² / 1000).

laiMapping.timing: Compute LAI once from beginning-of-day canopy DM; do not use same-day production in same-day interception.

dailyAllocation.constraint: Shares sum exactly to 1 and partition each daily net DM gain once. Do not apply a second harvest-index multiplier.

production.stressIsolation: All stress terms are frozen/expected at zero for the production multiplier. This factor is a synthetic isolation input, not a stress-response prediction.
production.totalDryMatterInvariant: After each tick, total above-ground DM is assigned as canopy DM plus harvestable DM.

soil.purpose: Synthetic high-pool stress isolation only; no soil fertility claim.

rootZone.method: FAO-56 frozen v4 input shape; synthetic isolation values only
rootZone.purpose: ETo, precipitation, and irrigation are zero so this input keeps water stress at zero; root-zone response is not evaluated.

dailyEnvironment.classification: synthetic software forcing; not Ohayou source weather or measured solar radiation

fieldUnits.dliNaturalMol: mol PAR/m²/day; a distinct optional field that is never converted or used as a fallback by this equation family

dailyEnvironment.missingSolarControl: Day 4 has explicit null total solar radiation and day 5 omits the solar field (runtime undefined); both rows have synthetic DLI as a decoy. Both representations are unavailable, must not use DLI as fallback, must hold DM pools, and must record the missing total-solar qualification reason.

jsonSerializationCases.knownZero: JSON.stringify/parse must preserve day 3 solarRadiationMJm2Day as numeric 0.
jsonSerializationCases.explicitNull: JSON.stringify/parse must preserve day 4 solarRadiationMJm2Day as null.
jsonSerializationCases.omittedUndefined: Day 5 has no solarRadiationMJm2Day property; a runtime undefined value serializes as an omitted property and remains unavailable after parse.

syntheticInputs.recurrence: Starting with canopy C0=10 and harvestable H0=5 g/m²: for each known numeric solar input, compute LAI from beginning-of-day C, I=Rs×(1-exp(-1.09×LAI)), gain=1.16×I×1, Cnext=C+0.6×gain, Hnext=H+0.4×gain, and total=Cnext+Hnext. For known zero solar, I and gain are exactly zero. For null or omitted/undefined solar, production is unavailable and both pools hold regardless of DLI. All calculations are unrounded double-precision arithmetic.

expected.independentRecurrenceEvaluation: Rows below were calculated directly from the stated recurrence and synthetic values, independently of the Ohayou kernel, application engine, and tests. No candidate engine execution was performed.

expected.unsupportedHistoricalAndV6Records: An unsupported historical record and an incomplete/unknown v6 record each retain the exact distinctive stored summary sentinel and frozen config; neither is replayed.
expected.replay: JSON serialize and parse the complete RunRecord. A second simulateRun using only its persisted config and exact envSeries must match the first run's events, final cell state, qualification reasons, and summary exactly.

acceptanceChecks.dispatch: Explicit crop-model-v4 + run-inputs-v4 + crop-parameters-v6 selects OHAYOU-SPRING-CONTROL-TOTAL-SOLAR-RUE-V1; v5 remains LINTUL-net-RUE.
acceptanceChecks.dailyRows: Assert each preregistered LAI, intercepted-solar fraction and amount, DM gain, and ending pool under the arithmetic-only tolerances below.
acceptanceChecks.knownZeroSolar: Day 3 produces exactly zero intercepted solar and DM gain; both pools and total hold exactly.
acceptanceChecks.unknownSolarNoDliFallback: Day 4 null solar and day 5 omitted/undefined solar both remain unavailable despite present synthetic DLI; no numeric production is calculated, both pools hold exactly, and the daily qualification reason is recorded.
acceptanceChecks.poolClosure: At every tick total DM equals canopy DM plus harvestable DM exactly; unrounded net DM increment minus both pool increments meets the closure bound.
acceptanceChecks.stressIsolation: Heat, cold, nitrogen, water, pest and total production stress multipliers remain exactly zero/one as preregistered; no harvest occurs.
acceptanceChecks.deterministicReplay: After JSON serialize/parse of the persisted RunRecord, events, final cell state, qualification reasons, and summary are exactly equal across full replays of frozen config and envSeries.
acceptanceChecks.freezeForkTwinPreservation: freezeRunModelInputsV4, timeline.forkRun, and twin.createTwinRunRecord preserve crop-parameters-v6 and the complete solar envSeries; fork/twin RunRecords replay exactly from persisted inputs.
acceptanceChecks.unsupportedSummaryPreservation: Unsupported historical and incomplete/unknown v6 records retain the distinctive stored summary sentinel and frozen config exactly without replay.
acceptanceChecks.jsonSerialization: Known zero remains numeric 0, explicit null remains null, and omitted/undefined remains omitted/unavailable after RunRecord JSON round-trip.
acceptanceChecks.legacyV5Preservation: The existing water-sa-2018-dynamic-canopy-engine-fixture.json crop-parameters-v5 LINTUL path retains its frozen DLI/PAR interpretation and exact replay; no v5 record is reinterpreted as Ohayou.

leafAreaIndex.rationale: Synthetic double-precision evaluation of the frozen canopy-to-LAI equation only.

interceptedSolarRadiation.rationale: Multiplication and extinction-equation arithmetic only; not a weather or crop-error tolerance.

dailyDryMatterGain.rationale: Frozen RUE multiplication and synthetic stress factor only; not a predictive threshold.

poolState.rationale: Unrounded two-pool additions from the preregistered allocation shares only.

dailyDryMatterClosure.residual: total DM increment minus canopy DM increment minus harvestable DM increment
dailyDryMatterClosure.rationale: Numerical conservation invariant on unrounded synthetic pool transfers.

tolerances.exactChecks: Dispatch/version, zero and both unknown-light representations, no DLI fallback, harvest-event count, total-pool sum, freeze/fork/twin version preservation, JSON serialization semantics, unsupported-summary preservation, persisted replay equality, and v5 compatibility are exact. These checks establish software behavior only.
